senses.gloss: m. = h. שָׁלוֹם, perfection, soundness, health, peace.
units: <cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Psalms 38:4">Targ. Ps. XXXVIII, 4</cite>.
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Judges 11:13">Targ. Jud. XI, 13</cite>.
<cite ref="Onkelos Deuteronomy 20:10">Targ. Deut. XX, 10</cite> (Y. ed. Vien. <he>לְשׁלֵּם</he>, corr. acc.). Ib. 11 (Y. I <he>דִּשְׁלֵם</he>, corr. acc.; a. fr.).—
<cite ref="Taanit 24b:6">Taan. 24ᵇ</cite> they called to me in my dream, <he>ש׳ טב לרב טב וכ׳</he> good health to the good teacher from the good Lord &c.
<cite ref="Taanit 9b:1">Ib. 9ᵇ</cite> <he>ליזלו רבנן בש׳</he> may our teachers (you) go in peace.
Yoma 71ᵇ, v. עֲמַם II; a. v. fr.—שאל בש׳ to inquire after the health of; to salute.
<cite ref="Onkelos Genesis 43:27">Targ. Gen. XLIII, 27</cite>; a. fr. (v. also <cite ref="O01293"><he>סְעַר</he> I</cite>).—

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Berakhot 2:1:15">Y. Ber. II, 4ᵇ</cite>, a. e. <he>לא שאיל בשְׁלָמֵיה</he>, v. <cite ref="G00598"><he>זְעֵיר</he> II</cite>; <cite ref="Yoma 2a:4">ib.</cite> <he>דלא שאל בשְׁלָמִי</he> he did not salute me.
Ber. 9ᵇ כי … שאיל בשְׁלוֹמֵיה וכ׳ when you go up there (to Palestine), greet my brother &c.; a. fr.—יהב ש׳ to offer peace, salute.
<cite ref="Taanit 23a:5">Taan. 23ᵃ</cite> sq. <he>יהבו ליה ש׳ ולא וכ׳</he> they saluted him, but he did not look at them in a friendly way (give no sign of recognition).

<cite ref="Taanit 23b:3">Ib.ᵇ</cite> <he>מ״ט כי יהיבנא למר ש׳ וכ׳</he> when we saluted you, why did you make no recognition? <cite ref="Gittin 62a:12">Gitt. 62ᵃ</cite> <he>מקדים ויהיב להו ש׳</he> saluted them (gentiles) first; a. fr.—V. <cite ref="B01364"><he>בִּשְׁלָמָא</he></cite>.
